name: Sushi & Nem
kurzbeschreibung:
**Sushi & Nem in Füssen**

Discover authentic Japanese flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Sushi & Nem in Füssen**, we bring you a unique fusion of traditional Japanese cuisine and Alpine charm. Indulge in fresh **sushi**, delicate **sashimi**, and flavorful **nem** dishes, all crafted with the finest ingredients.

Our menu features a variety of **sushi rolls**, from classic **California Rolls** to creative specialties like **Spicy Tuna** or **Avocado & Crab**. For those craving something lighter, our **sashimi** selection—made with the freshest fish—is a must-try.

But we don’t stop there! Our **nem** dishes, inspired by Japanese **tempura** and **yakitori**, offer a crispy, savory experience. Try our **Agedashi Tofu** or **Chicken Katsu**, perfectly fried and served with tangy sauces.

Pair your meal with a selection of premium **sake**, refreshing **Japanese beers**, or a crisp **green tea** to complete your dining experience.

Located in the picturesque town of **Füssen**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and the stunning **Alps**, **Sushi & Nem** is the perfect spot for a culinary adventure. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our warm hospitality and delicious food will leave you wanting more.

Come taste the fusion of **Japan** and **Tirol**—where every bite tells a story!
